plan: Deep-copy the recipe on entry so adapt never mutates inputs; print_original returns authored_text verbatim.
Scale all quantities (top-level and component ingredient lists) by Fraction(target_yield)/Fraction(yield).

Resolve each excluded ingredient via a work queue: pick the catalog choice with lowest (priority, catalog index); apply name, quantity_factor, unit, preparation, wording_changes, equipment add/remove, yield_factor, and additional ingredients.

Carry a per-chain ancestry list through replacements and into additional ingredients: a revisited name yields 'substitution cycle involving NAME'; no candidate yields 'no substitution for NAME'; a result or extra whose name is still excluded emits a reintroduction warning and is substituted again (chaining).
Accumulate all reasons in a set across every ingredient, then check the final equipment set against available_equipment, so all independently applicable reasons are reported together, sorted.

On success, renormalize quantities if any yield_factor applied (recipe stays at target yield), apply collected wording pairs to every instruction string in order, sort equipment and warnings, and return {possible, recipe, choices, warnings, reasons}.

Ship a __main__ acceptance suite covering 3→5 scaling, chained substitution, verb+equipment change, reintroduced exclusion, multiple simultaneous reasons, deterministic priority with tie-break, and exact original printing with no input mutation.
mechanisms: priority-ranked candidate selection keyed on (priority, catalog index)
work-queue chained substitution with ancestry-based cycle detection
reason-set accumulation for exhaustive impossibility reporting
equipment as a set with add/discard and final subset check
deferred global wording rewrite applied to all instruction lists
authored_text passthrough for exact original printing
